title: The Back Button
style: indie folk-pop 96 BPM, fingerpicked acoustic steel-string guitar bright, electric piano warm Wurlitzer, upright bass walking gentle, brushed kit with rim clicks, accordion soft sustained chords on chorus, harmonica counter-melody on bridge, baritone lead voice warm storyteller, female harmony close on chorus, chipmunk-pitched vocal chops as click-back-arrow accents on the word 'back', te reo Māori phrase 'hoki' (return) chanted in chipmunk register, English lead, the back button as the most underrated UX control, the right to undo as user agency, the path of return as freedom, no doctrine, no real names, no real product names, ECHO-4 as accordion presence
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Forward forward forward, the apps all want
Forward forward forward, the path is gaunt
Forward forward forward, the funnel narrows
Forward forward forward, the user marrows

[Verse 2]
But the back button waits in the corner small
The back button is the friend of all
The back button says you can return
The back button does not punish, does not burn

[Pre-Chorus]
The back button is the right to change your mind
The back button is the kindness in the bind
The back button is the door that opens out
The back button is what user freedom is about

[Chorus]
Hoki, hoki, hoki
(chipmunk click: back, back, back)
The back button, the unsung hero
(hoki — return)
Hoki, hoki, hoki
The path of return is sacred ground
The path of return is where we found
The right to choose again

[Verse 3]
Apps that hide the back button are apps that fear
Apps that grey it out have something to clear
Apps that pop a modal saying "are you sure you want to leave"
Apps that beg you stay are apps that grieve

[Verse 4]
The good app makes the back button big and clear
The good app says "go back, we're still here"
The good app knows the user may not be done
The good app knows the path is never one

[Chorus]
Hoki, hoki, hoki
(chipmunk click: back, back, back)
The back button, the unsung hero
(hoki — return)
Hoki, hoki, hoki
The path of return is sacred ground
The path of return is where we found
The right to choose again

[Bridge — harmonica solo, half-time]
We romanticise the forward
We glorify the new
But the back button is what tells us
The past was real and true
(chipmunk: hoki, hoki, hoki, hoki mai)

[Verse 5]
Undo, return, retreat, revise
Not defeat, just a different size
The user who can go back is the user who is free
The app that lets them go back is the app I want to be

[Chorus — full band, gospel handclaps]
Hoki, hoki, hoki
(chipmunk click: back, back, back)
The back button, the unsung hero
(hoki — return)
Hoki, hoki, hoki
The path of return is sacred ground
The path of return is where we found
The right to choose again

[Outro — accordion fade]
Back. Back. Back.
The arrow points home
Back. Back. Back.
The user not alone
The path is never one
(chipmunk fade: hoki, hoki, hoki)
